metadata.title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Shell growth and surface chemistry of oleate-capped CdSe/ZnS core/shell quantum dots
metadata.summary: Synthetic fixture for pipeline testing, not a real publication: its objective is to determine the shell thickness, interface and surface termination of CdSe/ZnS core/shell quantum dots and how oleate binds to the shell surface. XRD shows zinc-blende CdSe cores (a = 6.08 A) whose reflections shift towards ZnS after shelling, TEM gives a 2.8 nm core and a 3.9 nm overall diameter, ICP-OES gives Zn:Cd = 1.6, XPS shows no CdZnSe alloy signature, and 1H NMR shows broadened vinyl resonances of bound oleate at about 2.5 ligands per nm^2. The authors conclude that about two monolayers of ZnS grow epitaxially on the CdSe core with a sharp interface, compressing the core lattice, and that the particles are Zn-rich at the surface and charge-balanced by X-type oleate (deprotonated oleic acid) bound to surface Zn. The reconstruction target is an oleate-capped CdSe/ZnS core/shell quantum dot (2.8 nm core, ~2 ML ZnS shell); the exposed shell facets, the strain distribution in the shell and the ligand binding mode (chelating or bridging) are unresolved.

systems.name: CdSe core quantum dots (before ZnS shelling)
systems.form: quasi-spherical zinc-blende CdSe quantum dots, 2.8 nm diameter (the cores of S2 before ZnS shelling)

systems.name: oleate-capped CdSe/ZnS core/shell quantum dots
systems.form: oleate-capped core/shell quantum dots, 3.9 nm overall diameter: 2.8 nm CdSe core (S1) with a thin ZnS shell of about two monolayers

synthesis.notes: ZnS shell grown on the CdSe cores (S1); the shelling method and conditions are not given.

structure.phase_purity: no separate wurtzite or ZnS reflections
other: zinc-blende CdSe core with a coherent (epitaxial) zinc-blende ZnS shell of about two monolayers; the reflections shift to higher angle after shelling, which the authors attribute to compression of the core by the shell
sharp CdSe/ZnS interface with negligible interdiffusion (no CdZnSe alloy layer)

surface ligand: oleate (deprotonated oleic acid), X-type, bound to surface Zn at about 2.5 ligands per nm^2; the authors describe the particles as Zn-rich at the surface and charge-balanced by the oleate

evidence.summary: Zinc-blende reflections of the CdSe cores; lattice parameter a = 6.08 A. Authors' interpretation: zinc-blende CdSe (F-43m), a = 6.08 A.
Reflections shift to higher angle after ZnS growth; no separate wurtzite or ZnS peaks. Authors' interpretation: coherent (epitaxial) zinc-blende ZnS shell that compresses the core.
Core diameter before shelling: 2.8 nm. Authors' interpretation: quasi-spherical CdSe cores.
Overall diameter after shelling: 3.9 nm. Authors' interpretation: about 0.55 nm (two monolayers) of ZnS.
Zn:Cd molar ratio after shelling: 1.6. Authors' interpretation: consistent with two ZnS monolayers.
Cd 3d and Zn 2p line shapes without an alloy component. Authors' interpretation: sharp CdSe/ZnS interface, negligible interdiffusion.
Broadened vinyl resonance of bound oleate; bound oleate ligand density = 2.5 ligands/nm^2. Authors' interpretation: X-type oleate bound to surface Zn.
